criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.

Given the Command Center, when any tab renders, then .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json are both committed in this repo and every tab reads its content from them at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given the Command Center, when any tab is shown, then .colaberry/manifest.json is committed in this repo and every tab shows how old that data is and warns when the age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
Given the AI system, when prompted, then it generates a list of video ideas.
Given an inappropriate idea, when flagged, then it is removed from the list.
Trust: All generated ideas are logged for review.
Given a video idea, when processed, then the system generates a script.
Given an incomplete script, when reviewed, then it is flagged for human completion.
Trust: All scripts are logged for review.
Given a generated script, when uncertain, then it is flagged for review.
Given a flagged item, when reviewed, then it is either approved or rejected.
Trust: All flagged items are logged with reviewer actions.
Given a script, when processed, then the system produces educational content.
Given incorrect content, when reviewed, then it is flagged for correction.
Trust: All produced content is logged for review.
Given a video, when processed, then the system generates subtitles.
Given incorrect subtitles, when reviewed, then they are flagged for correction.
Trust: All subtitles are logged for review.
Given a video, when processed, then the system generates a thumbnail.
Given an inappropriate thumbnail, when reviewed, then it is flagged for redesign.
Trust: All thumbnails are logged for review.
Given a completed video, when ready, then it is uploaded to YouTube.
Given a failed upload, when retried, then it succeeds or logs an error.
Trust: All uploads are logged with status.
Given audience data, when analyzed, then the system provides insights.
Given incorrect insights, when reviewed, then they are flagged for correction.
Trust: All analysis results are logged for review.
Given video data, when monitored, then the system provides performance metrics.
Given incorrect metrics, when reviewed, then they are flagged for correction.
Trust: All performance data is logged for review.
Given AI insights, when applied, then engagement strategies are updated.
Given ineffective strategies, when reviewed, then they are flagged for revision.
Trust: All strategy changes are logged for review.
Given audience data, when analyzed, then the system suggests subscriber growth strategies.
Given ineffective strategies, when reviewed, then they are flagged for revision.
Trust: All strategy suggestions are logged for review.
Given the platform, when fully integrated, then all features work seamlessly.
Given integration issues, when identified, then they are flagged for correction.
Trust: All integration changes are logged for review.
Given a new video script is generated, When it is flagged for review, Then it must be approved by a content manager before publication.
Given a video script is approved, When it is published, Then an entry is created in the audit log with the approval details.
Trust: Given a video script is flagged, When it is approved or rejected, Then the action is recorded in the audit trail.
